verdict.rationale: Finix ships an official MCP server that lets AI agents query Finix API documentation for accurate answers (finix-docs-21, finix-docs-27, finix-probe-2), which is a step toward AI-native interaction, but the evidence only describes documentation Q&A, not natural-language commands that actually perform operations (e.g., creating payouts, onboarding sellers, managing disputes) within the product. Missing for 10: evidence of NL commands executing real actions/transactions, broader agentic tool coverage beyond docs Q&A, and independent confirmation of this MCP server working in practice.
